Mina: Morning release train check  quick note: we're doing an embeddings route rebalance as part of v3.7.4 rollout. Expect canary traffic at 08:50 UTC.
Alex: Canary live @08:50. Saw a tiny p95 uptick (~+30ms) around 08:55 on embeddings-infer. No errors.
Devin: Looking at host-level queues. A config change to batching window interacted poorly with KV cache warmup on canary hosts. Rolling a quick config revert for canary batching window now.
Devin: Command: `kubectl -n canary set env deployment/worker BATCH_WINDOW_MS=16`
deploy-bot: [08:59 UTC] Canary config change applied. pods ready: 3/3. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/2102
Alex: After revert p95 trended back to baseline in ~2m. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeddings/overview  monitoring apac/eu clusters.
Mina: Because this affected latency, instituting a short release hold for routing and batching changes: 09:05-10:05 UTC. If you need an exemption include risk statement + validation steps.
Devin: Running a 30m synthetic load test to validate the revert; will report pass/fail.
Mina: Changelog note queued: "batching window revert on canary; embeddings rebalance; temporary release hold 09:05-10:05 UTC". PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/1337
Alex: Thx team. Keep updates terse here and tag @oncall if customer impact appears. :thumbsup:
